description: This file defines the WorkMailMessageFlowClient class for interacting with the Amazon WorkMail Message Flow service API, extending the base AwsClient class and including method signatures for message content operations.

classes.name: WorkMailMessageFlowClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon WorkMail Message Flow service, providing methods to retrieve and submit raw message content.

methods.name: getRawMessageContent
methods.description: Retrieves the raw message content from the service.

methods.name: getRawMessageContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the raw message content.

methods.name: putRawMessageContent
methods.description: Submits raw message content to the service.
